questions.q: Why does this lesson say automation without notification is "barely better than no process at all"?
options: Because validation rules stop working without an Email Alert
Because a process that locks a record but never tells a human doesn't actually get acted on
Because Salesforce requires every object to have an Email Alert configured
Because approval processes cannot be activated without one
questions.explain: None of this chapter's tools notify anyone by themselves. A locked record nobody hears about just sits there until someone happens to notice.

questions.q: What does a merge field like {!Shift.ServiceResource} do inside an Email Template?
options: It blocks the email from sending until the field is filled in
It pulls live data from the record that triggered the notification into the email
It creates a new custom field on the Shift object
It converts the template into a validation rule
questions.explain: Merge fields pull real values from the triggering record, which is what makes one template reusable and specific instead of generic.

questions.q: The notification template selected in Step 4 of the approval process wizard is...
options: A completely different mechanism from Email Alerts
Only usable one time, then discarded
The exact same kind of Email Template covered in this lesson
Only available in Developer Edition orgs
questions.explain: Step 4's notification template is a standard Email Template, built the same way as any other, just selected for use inside the approval process.

questions.q: Which of these is NOT one of the four core pieces of configuring an Email Alert?
options: Object
Recipient Type
Email Template
Approval Step Number
questions.explain: An Email Alert needs an Object, an Email Template, a Recipient Type, and optionally a From Address. Approval Step Number isn't part of its configuration.

questions.q: Besides approval processes, where else can an Email Alert be used as an action?
options: Only inside Validation Rules
Only inside Formula fields
Flow, and Workflow Rules in older orgs
Nowhere else; Email Alerts only exist inside approval processes
questions.explain: Email Alerts are a reusable action usable from Flow and from Workflow Rules in orgs that still have them, not just from approval processes.
